subject: reasoning
question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(15, 135, 6)(12, 84, 5)
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**1st number × (1st number - 3rd number) = 2nd number**

Here, (15, 135, 6)

15 × (15 - 6)

15 × 9 = 135;

For, (12, 84, 5)</p&
